name: B10-0124/2025 (ECR) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking others to act. It asks the European Commission to assess how opposition politicians in Türkiye are targeted through courts, and to watch erosion of local democracy more closely. It asks the EU's diplomatic service to set up a team to document cases. It asks the Venice Commission, a legal advisory body, for an urgent opinion on mayoral dismissals and charges against opposition figures. It also calls for the Kurdish peace process to restart.

- No law changes; Parliament only asks the Commission, EU diplomatic service and Venice Commission to act.
- It concerns opposition mayors and politicians in Türkiye facing dismissals, arrests and legal cases.
- Next: those bodies decide whether to respond; the resolution is sent to them and to Türkiye's government.
